quote: Do any human beings ever realize life while they live it?—every, every minute?
source: Thornton Wilder, Our Town, Act III (Emily Webb) (Coward-McCann, 1938)
speaker: Emily Webb

evidence.where: Act III of Our Town, Emily to the Stage Manager after she relives her twelfth birthday; first edition confirmed as Coward-McCann, New York, 1938 through rare book catalogue records
evidence.edition: Our Town: A Play in Three Acts (Coward-McCann, 1938)

reason: The line is Emily’s question to the Stage Manager in Act III, in this wording, and the Stage Manager answers that saints and poets maybe do some. The common variant beginning Does anyone ever realize life is the misquotation; the proposal used the correct form. Publisher and year are right.
